Subject: Centre Formation Oujda — Ready for Review and Deployment

Hi [Boss Name],

The Centre Formation Oujda application is ready for review. I prepared a production build and a release bundle for you.

Quick details
- Suggested domain: https://www.centreformationoujda.com
- Frontend build: `frontend/dist` (Vite production build)
- Backend: Node + Express + Prisma (SQLite by default)
- Release archive: `dist/release.zip` (attached)

Key features implemented
- Product catalog, cart, and direct checkout
- Stripe checkout integration with webhook handling
- Course discovery, teacher course creation, student enrollments
- Admin order management (status updates, CSV export)
- Responsive UI with Tailwind + MDB React UI Kit

How to run locally
1. Backend
   - cd backend
   - npm install
   - npx prisma generate
   - npx prisma db push
   - npm run dev

2. Frontend
   - cd frontend
   - npm install
   - npm run dev

Release contents
- `dist/release.zip` — full project archive excluding node_modules and local build artifacts
- `dist/deployment-checklist.md` — step-by-step deploy instructions

Next recommended steps
1. Register/point the domain `centreformationoujda.com`.
2. Deploy backend and frontend to Render (or chosen hosting) and set env vars (`JWT_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`, `STRIPE_*`, `FRONTEND_URL`).
3. Configure Stripe webhook to point to `/api/payments/webhook`.

If you want, I can:
- Push the repo to a remote GitHub repo and create a release.
- Deploy to Render or a VPS and provide the live URL.

Best,
